inputs.description: Metadata about the Navier-Stokes snapshot(s) and auxiliary data used for analysis.

snapshot_files.description: List of HDF5 snapshot files exported by the Navier-Stokes solver.

environment_file.description: Environment JSON containing fluid density, viscosity, and domain configuration.

turbine_geometry_file.description: Optional geometry/region definition file for turbine surfaces, rotor disk, wake region, etc.

config.description: Analysis configuration controlling turbulence metrics, integration regions, and thresholds.

region_of_interest.description: Name of the region to analyze: 'full_domain', 'rotor_disk', 'wake_region', etc.

derivative_scheme.description: Scheme used for computing velocity gradients.

smoothing_filter.description: Optional smoothing applied before turbulence metrics.

q_criterion_threshold.description: Threshold for vortex identification using Q-criterion.

surface_definition.description: Name of turbine surface region to integrate over.

comparison_targets.description: List of metrics to compare with test data.

results.description: Post-processed flow metrics and performance indicators.

flow_paths.description: Representative streamlines or pathlines computed from velocity fields.

points.description: Ordered list of 3D points along the streamline.

velocity_statistics.description: Statistical properties of the velocity field in the region of interest.

speed_histogram.description: Histogram of speed magnitudes for visualization.

energy_transport.description: Energy transport metrics derived from velocity and density.

kinetic_energy_field.description: Path to derived HDF5 dataset containing kinetic energy density.

energy_flux_integral.description: Integrated kinetic energy flux across a defined plane or surface.

turbulence_metrics.description: Derived turbulence quantities based on velocity gradients.

vorticity_field.description: Path to derived HDF5 dataset containing vorticity magnitude.

q_criterion_field.description: Path to derived HDF5 dataset containing Q-criterion values.

turbulence_intensity.description: Scalar turbulence intensity metric for the region of interest.

instability_indicators.description: Indicators of flow separation, stall, and unsteady oscillations.

regions_of_separation.description: List of region identifiers where separation is detected.

oscillation_modes.description: Dominant oscillation frequencies extracted from time-series data.

loading_and_performance.description: Force and moment metrics derived from pressure and shear fields.

pressure_forces.description: Integrated pressure forces [Fx, Fy, Fz] on turbine surfaces.

shear_forces.description: Integrated viscous shear forces [Fx, Fy, Fz].

net_moment.description: Total moment vector [Mx, My, Mz] about the reference axis.

comparison_metrics.description: Comparison of simulation metrics with experimental or benchmark data.

deviation_map.description: Path to a deviation field or visualization asset.
